title:
Effect of obesity on inhibitory control in preadolescents during stop-signal 
task. An event-related potentials study
description: This EEG dataset comprises electrophysiological recordings from 57 obese and non-obese preadolescents performing a stop-signal task, designed to investigate the effect of obesity on inhibitory control mechanisms. Event-related potentials were recorded using a 128-channel Geodesic Hydrocell Sensor Net system. The dataset includes participant demographic information (age, gender, BMI, weight status) and raw, unprocessed EEG data acquired at the Arkansas Children Nutrition Center.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a Geodesic Net Amps 300 system with 128-channel Geodesic Hydrocell Sensor Net (Magstim EGI, Eugene OR, USA) running Netstation 4.5.2 software. Stimuli were designed and administered using E-Prime software (Version 2). Raw data files contain no preprocessing operations.
